description: This file defines an interface ModifyCommandAdapter in the package org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter. It acts as a mixin for modify commands, extending the Adapter interface for generic Command types. It provides default implementations for methods related to criteria, actions, and response handling associated with protocol modify commands.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the default set of criteria for modify commands, specifically those related to commands.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the default set of actions applicable to modify commands: CREATE, MODIFY, and DELETE.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether the command adapter is intended for responses; defaults to false.
